claims.text: The schema requires schema, id, source, target, kind, agent and payload, fixes schema to the lineage.family/1 constant, and closes the object with additionalProperties false.
The kind enum admits exactly capabilities, events.read and call, and the id pattern forbids the reserved invalid0 value with a not const clause.

The allOf branches specialize payload per kind: capabilities requires an empty payload and forbids after, events.read requires after with bounded limit and wait_ms, and call validates tool and args against a oneOf of closed tool shapes.
Identifier patterns bound source and target to 1 to 64 characters starting alphanumeric, agent to a lowercase identity, and after to the safe-integer maximum.

decision.rule: Change here when the family envelope fields, kind-specific payload shapes or identifier patterns need to change.
decision.failure: An envelope with an unknown field passes, a kind carries a payload for another kind, or a forbidden identifier is accepted.
